verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an LLM gateway and SDK like LiteLLM, so the axis applies. The evidence covers a unified completion() interface, OpenAI-compatible responses, routing, logging and budgets. Nothing in it documents API versioning, version pinning guarantees or a deprecation policy. A consistent interface across providers is a different capability from versioned APIs with documented deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
